method: Independent static source/protocol review and verification of frozen source/Git blobs and producer lightweight-test log.

confirmed_finding.problem: Lexical $x.into() could be mistaken for scalar header parameter x while a local macro substituted Vec receiver buf. A method-name metavariable could also construct into without a literal .into call.
confirmed_finding.fix: Every opt-in Rust file rejects macro_rules and dollar-sign metavariables before locating literal into sites or taking the no-sites early return.
confirmed_finding.regression: Two complete owner-file counterexamples and no-literal-into counterexamples in test_macro_expansion_cannot_substitute_a_container_receiver.

reviewed_boundaries: Default primitive_parameter_into=False remains at legacy call sites; new rules are an explicit prospective profile, and historical answers are not reclassified.

Literal into requires a bare unshadowed scalar header parameter and zero arguments. Fields, expressions, containers, custom trait/impl declarations, extra imports and arbitrary methods remain excluded by the combined gates.
Actual target conversion validity remains the job of real rustc. The source model supplied is copied unchanged; strip_check removes only the unscored outer self-check field.
Public feedback pairs existing public arguments with existing public expected/observed values and unchanged real diagnostics and aggregate contract verdicts.
The sole repair-feedback call follows public execution. Hidden execution happens only after public success and unconditionally ends the cell before another inference request.

Full/query share edit authority within each language; all four main arms use three submissions, 2048 maximum output tokens, 8192 context tokens and 300 seconds per request, with common native execution limits.
The 7B choice and simultaneous profile/feedback changes are disclosed adaptive follow-up. Main requires fresh v6 calibration; old v5 eligibility is not imported.
Partial SSE output remains a lower bound, not a complete response; timeouts end the cell instead of granting extra repair requests.
pending: The separate real-rustc/native profile controls and fresh v6 calibration/main have not been executed by this review. Their future evidence needs its own source/command/result binding.
review_result: The independently found macro-substitution bypass is closed in the final source; no other substantive new authority, feedback, historical-reclassification or budget issue was found in this inspection.
limits: A finite lexical admission profile is not a general Rust parser or hostile-compiler sandbox.
This review is not a language-soundness proof or an Agent-productivity result.
Legacy source files outside the opt-in branch retain their older behavior; the new macro guard does not retroactively strengthen or rescore old runs.
Changes from v5 cannot be attributed independently to language, model capability, conversion support or feedback.
